summary: Iteration 2 testing — 4 new features (ongkir, lockout+reset, photo upload, SEO/PWA). Backend pytest: 35/36 passed (1 real bug: brute-force lockout fails behind ingress due to IP rotation). Frontend: forgot-password + reset-password flows work, ongkir autocomplete + fallback estimate work end-to-end, admin diagnostic photo upload (before/after) works with thumbnail preview, diagnostic PUT preserves photos. MISSING: schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD script and manifest.json <link rel=manifest> from index.html — neither feature was implemented despite being listed.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout never triggers behind the preview ingress because request.client.host returns the load-balancer IP which rotates across multiple pods (observed 10.211.3.156 and 10.211.3.157). Failed attempts split across ~2 IPs so fails never reaches MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS=5. After 7 consecutive wrong-password logins, API still returns 401, not 429. Fix: extract client IP from X-Forwarded-For header (first entry), falling back to request.client.host. Example: `xff = request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for',''); ip = xff.split(',')[0].strip() if xff else (request.client.host if request.client else 'unknown')`.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing schema.org LocalBusiness JSON-LD <script type="application/ld+json"> AND missing <link rel="manifest" href="/manifest.json" /> — feature listed in problem statement was not implemented. Only a stale HTML comment about manifest exists. File /app/frontend/public/manifest.json does exist but is never referenced.

issues: Date input uses native browser picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component — inconsistent with the rest of the app and forces US date format in an Indonesian app.

rca_of_the_issue: Brute-force lockout bug RCA: In /app/backend/server.py line 424 login() computes identifier = f'{ip}:{email}' where ip = request.client.host. Behind the k8s ingress, request.client.host returns the in-cluster pod/LB IP rather than the real client IP, AND that LB IP rotates across at least 2 addresses (10.211.3.156/157 observed in db.login_attempts). Each bucket therefore accumulates ~2–3 fails before the request lands on another LB, never crossing MAX_FAILED_ATTEMPTS=5. Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login 7 times with wrong password — all return 401, db.login_attempts shows the fails distributed across several identifiers. Mitigation: parse the real client IP from X-Forwarded-For (first, leftmost value) and fall back to request.client.host only when the header is absent.
